user.title: Nulleinspeisung
user.description: Add Nulleinspeisung to Home Assistant. DTUs and Houses are added afterwards.

user.title: Add DTU
user.description: Enter the address and the administrator password of the OpenDTU.

data_description.url: Address of the DTU, for example 192.168.1.50 or http://opendtu.local
data_description.password: Administrator password of the DTU (user admin)
data_description.sun_angle: Sun elevation in degrees above which the Inverters must be delivering data (default 5)
data_description.staleness_time: Seconds without fresh Inverter data after which the DTU counts as stuck (default 120)
data_description.restart_wait: Seconds to wait after a restart before judging the DTU again; at least the staleness time plus 30 seconds (default 180)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure DTU
reconfigure.description: Change the address or the administrator password of this DTU.

data_description.url: Address of the DTU, for example 192.168.1.50 or http://opendtu.local
data_description.password: Administrator password of the DTU (user admin)
data_description.sun_angle: Sun elevation in degrees above which the Inverters must be delivering data (default 5)
data_description.staleness_time: Seconds without fresh Inverter data after which the DTU counts as stuck (default 120)
data_description.restart_wait: Seconds to wait after a restart before judging the DTU again; at least the staleness time plus 30 seconds (default 180)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the DTU. Check the address.

abort.already_configured: This DTU has already been added.
abort.wrong_dtu: The address belongs to a different DTU.

user.title: Add House
user.description: Give the House a name, its location and the sensor of its Grid Meter.

data_description.name: Name of the House, unique among Houses
data_description.grid_meter: Power sensor measuring the net power at the grid connection
data_description.grid_meter_sign: Whether the sensor reports import or export as positive values
data_description.tibber_home: The Tibber home whose prices this House uses. Each Tibber home can belong to one House.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure House
reconfigure.description: Give the House a name, its location and the sensor of its Grid Meter.

data_description.name: Name of the House, unique among Houses
data_description.grid_meter: Power sensor measuring the net power at the grid connection
data_description.grid_meter_sign: Whether the sensor reports import or export as positive values
data_description.tibber_home: The Tibber home whose prices this House uses. Each Tibber home can belong to one House.

inverters.title: Inverters
inverters.description: Choose the Inverters that belong to this House. An Inverter belongs to at most one House. You can leave this empty and add Inverters later.

data_description.inverters: Inverters of any DTU that are not assigned to another House

battery_backed.title: Battery-backed Inverters
battery_backed.description: Mark the Inverters that are fed by a DC Battery. All other chosen Inverters are PV Inverters.

data_description.battery_backed: Inverters whose input is a DC Battery

error.name_exists: A House with this name already exists.
error.inverter_assigned: An Inverter you chose already belongs to another House.
error.tibber_home_assigned: This Tibber home already belongs to another House.

init.title: Notifications and Tibber
init.description: Choose where repair issues are also sent, and enter your Tibber token to fetch electricity prices. Leave a field empty to go without.

data_description.notify_target: A notify entity that receives a message when a repair issue is raised
data_description.tibber_token: Personal access token from developer.tibber.com; it covers all homes of your Tibber account

dtu_unreachable.title: DTU {dtu} unreachable
dtu_unreachable.description: The DTU {dtu} does not answer on the network, so it cannot be restarted. Check its power and network connection.

restart_not_helping.title: Restarting DTU {dtu} does not help
restart_not_helping.description: The DTU {dtu} still delivers no data from its Inverters after several restarts. It is restarted less often now. Check for snow, a radio fault or a hardware problem.

prices_unavailable.title: Prices unavailable for {house}
prices_unavailable.description: There has been no electricity price for {house} for more than 15 minutes. Check the Tibber connection and the token. Prices are fetched again automatically.

tibber_token_rejected.title: Tibber token rejected
tibber_token_rejected.description: Tibber refused the token, so no prices can be fetched. Enter a valid token in the options of the integration.

grid_meter_failure.title: Grid Meter of House {house} delivers no data
grid_meter_failure.description: The Grid Meter of {house} has not delivered a value for three Update Intervals. The House holds or releases its Inverters as chosen in "On failure" and resumes by itself once the Grid Meter delivers again.

dtu_failure.title: No DTU of House {house} answers
dtu_failure.description: None of the DTUs of the Inverters of {house} answers on the network, so nothing can be controlled. The House holds or releases its Inverters as chosen in "On failure" and resumes by itself once a DTU answers again.
